Post Text:
Looking for a reliable long-term sourcing partner (cookware → EU)

We're building a cookware brand in Europe and are looking for a reliable, long-term partner who can find and source frying pans and pots for the EU market.

Phase 1 — market testing: dropshipping or small trial orders with no MOQ (or very low MOQ), shipped to Europe. We want to validate demand with minimal risk first.

Phase 2 — scaling: once testing goes well, we'll move to bulk orders with our own branding (OEM / private label) — custom logo, packaging, and regular shipments to Europe.

Important: products must be suitable for the EU market — we'll need EU food-contact test reports (EC 1935/2004, ideally LFGB) from an accredited lab and coating composition details for anything non-stick.

If this sounds like something you do, message me with your experience, product catalog, and how you'd handle the no-MOQ testing phase.
